name: siegestack
description: siegestack.com. Static pages, plus Netlify functions for the contact form, the consultant expertise form, and the private threads at /jesse and /nicole.

scripts.test: node scripts/test/forms.test.mjs && node scripts/test/sweep.test.mjs && node scripts/test/publish-gate.test.mjs && node scripts/test/input-guard.test.mjs && node scripts/test/page-index.test.mjs && node scripts/test/cross-coverage.test.mjs
scripts.test:defects: node scripts/test/forms.test.mjs --defects && node scripts/test/sweep.test.mjs --defects && node scripts/test/page-index.test.mjs --defects
scripts.netlify:build: npm run build:llms && npm run validate:pages && npm test
